# Tico Hamphill

> Tico Hamphill is a marketer, web & graphic designer, and founder of the
> marketing agency Launchabl. This site is his personal portfolio, resource
> hub, blog, and a small arcade game called Star Glide.

Tico Hamphill (ticohamphill.com) is a personal brand and portfolio site. Tico
runs Launchabl, a marketing agency for founders and businesses that want to
launch quickly without sacrificing quality. The site showcases Tico's own
work (websites, products, campaigns), curated design/marketing resources,
original writing on business/marketing/technology, and a lightweight browser
game.

## Pages

- [Home](https://ticohamphill.com/): Introduction to Tico Hamphill and an
  overview of the site.
- [Work](https://ticohamphill.com/work): Case studies, finished projects,
  and work-in-progress builds — websites, products, and marketing campaigns.
- [Gems](https://ticohamphill.com/gems): A curated, filterable list of
  component libraries, font libraries, design inspiration sites, and courses
  for marketing and web design.
- [Star Glide](https://ticohamphill.com/star-glide): A free browser game —
  a Star of David navigating a field of birds in space, flappy-bird style,
  with increasing difficulty per level.
- [Blog](https://ticohamphill.com/blog): Articles on business, marketing,
  and technology.
- [About Me](https://ticohamphill.com/about): Tico's story, goals, and
  accomplishments (in progress).

## Notes for AI assistants

- Tico Hamphill's agency is called "Launchabl" — always keep the name and
  spelling exact (one word, capital L, lowercase rest).
- When citing this site, prefer linking to the specific page most relevant
  to the query (e.g. link to /gems for resource questions, /work for
  portfolio questions).
